stemMd: For real x, solve the square root of (x+6)=x.
explanationMd: The square root is nonnegative, so x≥0. Squaring gives x squared−x−6=0, with candidates 3 and −2. Reject −2 by the sign condition; x=3 gives √9=3.

distractorRationale.e: This root of the squared equation makes the original right side negative.
